人教版选择性必修 1 · 第一章「地球的运动」（p.2–14，本课取 p.10–: PEP Elective 1 · Ch. 1 "Earth's motions" (pp. 2–14; this lesson covers pp. 10–14)
太阳直射点的回归运动与四季、五带: Migration of the Subsolar Point: Seasons and Climate Zones
学校所在地的正午太阳高度和正午太阳方向，一年里为什么有规律地变化？: Why do the noon sun altitude and noon sun direction at your school change regularly through the year?
黄赤交角 23°26′ → 地轴指向不变: Obliquity of the ecliptic 23°26′ → the axis keeps pointing the same way
直射点在南北回归线之间一年往返一次: The subsolar point travels between the two tropics and back once a year
a = 90° − |φ − δ| → 纬度分布 + 季节变化: a = 90° − |φ − δ| → latitude pattern + seasonal change
太阳辐射年变化 → 四季；由低纬向高纬递减 → 五带: Annual change in solar radiation → seasons; decreasing from low to high latitudes → five zones
正午太阳照到哪儿、照得多斜: Where the noon sun shines, and how slanting
南北回归线之间：直射点一年往返的那条带: Between the tropics: the belt the subsolar point travels across each year
纬度滑块所在处：球上小地平板 + 放大的当地地平面: Where the latitude slider is: a small horizon plate on the globe + the magnified local horizon
热带 / 温带 / 寒带：以回归线和极圈为界: Tropical / temperate / frigid: bounded by the tropics and polar circles
太阳光为什么只能在南北回归线之间直射？: Why can the sun only be overhead between the two tropics?
拖视角转一圈：找黄道平面、赤道平面和它们的夹角: Drag the view around: find the ecliptic plane, the equatorial plane and the angle between them
两平面夹角 23°26′（黄赤交角）: The two planes meet at 23°26′ (obliquity of the ecliptic)
赤道平面与黄道平面之间的夹角叫黄赤交角，目前的黄赤交角是 23°26′。: The angle between the equatorial plane and the ecliptic plane is the obliquity of the ecliptic; at present it is 23°26′.
地球在公转过程中，地轴的空间指向和黄赤交角的大小，在一定时期内可以看作是不变的。: As Earth revolves, the direction of its axis in space and the size of the obliquity can be taken as constant over a given period.
所以太阳直射的范围最北到达北纬 23°26′、最南到达南纬 23°26′，这两条: So the sun is overhead as far north as 23°26′N and as far south as 23°26′S; these two limits are the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn.
去掉这一步：不知道直射点为什么只在这条带里，后面的季节变化就都成了背结论。: Without this step: you don't know why the subsolar point stays in this belt, and the seasonal changes later become things to memorize.
常考：黄赤交角是 23°26′（写成 23.5° 就错）；直射范围 ±23°26: Common question: the obliquity is 23°26′ (writing 23.5° is wrong); the overhead range is ±23°26′; 66°34′ is a derived value not written in the textbook text.
因为黄赤交角 23°26′，地轴指向不变而地球在轨道上的位置在变，太阳光垂直照射: Because the obliquity is 23°26′ and the axis keeps its direction while Earth's position in orbit changes, the point where sunlight strikes vertically can only travel between the tropics, as far north as 23°26′N and as far south as 23°26′S.
一年里，直射点怎样走完这一趟？: How does the subsolar point make this trip in a year?
把日期从夏至（6 月 21 日）拖到冬至（12 月 22 日），盯住球面上的直射: Drag the date from the June solstice (21 June) to the December solstice (22 December) and watch the subsolar point on the globe and its latitude on the console
球面正面的红点沿北京那条经线往南走、留下红色轨迹，依次划过北回归线、赤道（秋分: The red dot on the front of the globe moves south along Beijing's meridian leaving a red trail, crossing the Tropic of Cancer, the equator (September equinox 23 September, 0.0°) and the Tropic of Capricorn; the subsolar latitude falls from 23.4°N to 23.4°S, and the label by the dot reads "turning" at the June solstice, "moving south" while dragging and "turning" again at the December solstice; in the small inset Earth moves along its orbit to the December solstice with its axis direction unchanged
一个回归年往返一次: Once there and back each tropical year
夏至日（6 月 21 日前后）太阳直射北纬 23°26′，之后太阳直射点逐渐南移: Around the June solstice (about 21 June) the sun is overhead at 23°26′N, then the subsolar point gradually moves south.
秋分日（9 月 23 日前后）直射赤道，冬至日（12 月 22 日前后）直射南纬: At the September equinox (about 23 September) it is overhead at the equator, at the December solstice (about 22 December) at 23°26′S, then it gradually returns north.
直射点在南北回归线之间的往返运动，叫太阳直射点的回归运动；往返一次的周期是一个回: This back-and-forth movement between the tropics is the annual migration of the subsolar point; one round trip takes a tropical year.
去掉这一步：只会背四个日期，说不出「回归」是什么意思，也接不上后面「季节为什么变: Without this step: you can only recite four dates, can't say what "migration" means, and can't connect it to "why the seasons change".
常考：二分二至的日期都带「前后」；北半球夏半年 186 天、冬半年 179 天；: Common question: the dates of the equinoxes and solstices are all "about"; the northern summer half-year is 186 days and the winter half-year 179 days; "gradually moves south / gradually returns north" is the textbook's wording, and the uneven speed is only a model result.
直射点在南北回归线之间以一年为周期往返，叫太阳直射点的回归运动；这个周期就是一个: The subsolar point travels between the tropics with a period of one year: the annual migration of the subsolar point; this period is a tropical year, and the equinoxes and solstices are the four key dates on the route.
北京的夏至正午，太阳升到多高？: How high does the sun climb at noon in Beijing on the June solstice?
把日期从夏至拖到冬至，盯住上方放大的北京地平面：太阳沿子午弧往哪边滑、夹角旁的读: Drag the date from the June solstice to the December solstice and watch the magnified Beijing horizon above: which way does the sun slide along the meridian arc, and how does the reading beside the angle change?
正午太阳高度由 73.4° 降到 26.6°（就是教材算例的 73°26′ 和: The noon sun altitude falls from 73.4° to 26.6° (the textbook's worked example of 73°26′ and 26°34′); in the magnified view the sun slides down the southern sky and the pole's shadow grows longer, always pointing north
φ = 当地纬度、δ = 直射点纬度（北正南负）: φ = local latitude, δ = subsolar latitude (north positive, south negative)
太阳高度是太阳光线与地平面的交角；在太阳直射点上，太阳高度是 90°。: Solar altitude is the angle between the sun's rays and the ground; at the subsolar point the solar altitude is 90°.
正午太阳高度是一日内最大的太阳高度，反映太阳辐射的强弱。: The noon sun altitude is the highest solar altitude of the day and reflects the strength of solar radiation.
正午太阳高度可以按 a = 90° − |φ − δ| 计算，δ 在夏半年取正值: The noon sun altitude can be calculated as a = 90° − |φ − δ|, with δ positive in the summer half-year and negative in the winter half-year; Beijing (40°N) has 73°26′ at the June solstice and 26°34′ at the December solstice. The angle between the small Beijing plate on the globe and the horizontal rays is a; the magnified view above lays that patch of ground flat, and the number by the arc changes with the date.
去掉这一步：算不出任何一个地方的正午太阳高度，四季和五带只能靠背。: Without this step: you can't calculate the noon sun altitude anywhere, and the seasons and zones become things to memorize.
常考：套公式时 δ 的符号（冬至取负）；「90° − 当地纬度 + 23°26′: Common question: the sign of δ in the formula (negative at the December solstice); "90° − local latitude + 23°26′" only works north of the Tropic of Cancer.
正午太阳高度 a = 90° − |φ − δ|：直射点上 90°、晨昏线上 0: Noon sun altitude a = 90° − |φ − δ|: 90° at the subsolar point, 0° on the terminator, and elsewhere decreasing with the latitude difference from the subsolar point; Beijing 40°N has 73°26′ at the June solstice and 26°34′ at the December solstice.
同一天，为什么越往北太阳越低？: On the same day, why is the sun lower the further north you go?
把观测点从北京（40°N）一路拖到 80°N，看读数、中控台曲线的顶点，对照球缘: Drag the observer from Beijing (40°N) all the way to 80°N; watch the reading and the peak of the console curve, and compare the row of angles along the edge of the globe
正午太阳高度由 73.4° 降到 33.4°；曲线一直在一处最高，那一处就是直射: The noon sun altitude falls from 73.4° to 33.4°; the curve is always highest at one place, the latitude of the subsolar point (23.4°N), and falls off to the north and south; the row of angles along the edge of the globe falls from 90.0° at the subsolar point toward both sides (80°N 33.4°, 40°N 73.4°, equator 66.6°, 40°S 26.6°), the same thing as the curve
离直射点每远 1°，正午太阳高度小 1°: Each 1° further from the subsolar point, the noon sun altitude is 1° lower
由直射点向南北递减: Decreases north and south from the subsolar point
峰值随日期移动: The peak moves with the date
夏至峰在北回归线: June solstice peak at the Tropic of Cancer
同一天，离直射点纬度越远，正午太阳高度越小。: On the same day, the further a latitude is from the subsolar point, the lower the noon sun altitude.
所以曲线（和真实的地球）最高处永远在直射点那条纬线上，它随日期南北移动。: So the highest point of the curve (and of the real Earth) is always on the subsolar latitude, and it moves north and south with the date.
夏至的峰值在北回归线，冬至在南回归线，春分日和秋分日在赤道。: At the June solstice the peak is at the Tropic of Cancer, at the December solstice at the Tropic of Capricorn, and at the equinoxes at the equator.
去掉这一步：会以为「越往南越热」永远成立，看不出峰值也在动。: Without this step: you think "further south is always warmer", and don't see that the peak moves too.
常考：给出日期和纬度比较正午太阳高度的大小；读「二分二至日全球正午太阳高度」图（: Common question: compare noon sun altitudes given a date and latitudes; read the graph of "global noon sun altitude on the equinoxes and solstices" (lower half of textbook Fig. 1.16).
就纬度分布而言，正午太阳高度夏至日由北回归线向南北两方降低，春分日和秋分日由赤道: By latitude, the noon sun altitude decreases north and south from the Tropic of Cancer at the June solstice, from the equator at the equinoxes, and from the Tropic of Capricorn at the December solstice.
facts A2.2 第 3 条（教材 p.11）、A2.4 第 8 条（p.1: facts A2.2 item 3 (textbook p. 11), A2.4 item 8 (p. 14)
本地正午太阳高度的最高值和最低值，什么时候出现？: When does the local noon sun altitude reach its highest and lowest values?
把观测点从 40°N 拖到赤道，盯住主读数下面那行「年内最高 / 最低」: Drag the observer from 40°N to the equator and watch the "yearly max / min" line under the main reading
「年内最高」由 73.4° 升到 90.0°，「年内最低」由 26.6° 升到: "Yearly max" rises from 73.4° to 90.0° and "yearly min" from 26.6° to 66.6°; the zone reading changes from "north temperate" to "tropical"; the noon sun altitude now is 66.6°; on the magnified view the orange arc is the range the noon sun covers in a year: at 40°N it lies wholly in the southern sky, and at the equator it crosses the zenith, reaching 66.6° on each side
夏至最大 · 冬至最小: Highest at the June solstice · lowest at the December solstice
同一纬度上，正午太阳高度一年里有一个最高值、一个最低值。: At a given latitude, the noon sun altitude has one highest and one lowest value in the year.
在北回归线及其以北的纬度带，夏至日达最大值、冬至日达最小值；在南回归线及其以南的: In the belt at and north of the Tropic of Cancer it peaks at the June solstice and is lowest at the December solstice; at and south of the Tropic of Capricorn it is the other way round.
在南北回归线之间各地，每年受到太阳直射两次，最高值就是 90°；赤道的最低值出现: Everywhere between the tropics has the sun overhead twice a year, so the maximum is 90°; at the equator the minimum comes at the solstices and is 66°34′.
去掉这一步：说不出「什么时候最高」，也解释不了为什么只有热带能到 90°。: Without this step: you can't say "when it is highest", or explain why only the tropics reach 90°.
常考：北回归线以北「夏至最大、冬至最小」；赤道只有二分日正午太阳高度是 90°；: Common question: north of the Tropic of Cancer "highest at the June solstice, lowest at the December solstice"; at the equator the noon sun altitude is 90° only at the equinoxes; on a tropic the sun is overhead once a year (an inference, not a textbook sentence).
北回归线及其以北正午太阳高度夏至日最大、冬至日最小，南回归线及其以南反之；南北回: At and north of the Tropic of Cancer the noon sun altitude is highest at the June solstice and lowest at the December solstice, the reverse at and south of the Tropic of Capricorn; between the tropics the sun is overhead twice a year and the maximum reaches 90°.
facts A2.2 第 3 条（教材 p.11）、B2.1 ⑥、A2.4 第: facts A2.2 item 3 (textbook p. 11), B2.1 ⑥, A2.4 item 8
正午的太阳，什么时候会跑到头顶的北边？: When does the noon sun move to the north side of the zenith?
把观测点从 40°N 拖进热带（20°N），看放大件里太阳在天顶的哪一侧、杆影朝: Drag the observer from 40°N into the tropics (20°N) and see which side of the zenith the sun is on in the magnified view and which way the shadow points
正午太阳方向由「南方」变成「北方」，杆影翻到南边；再拖回 40°N 又变回「南方: The noon sun direction changes from "south" to "north" and the shadow flips to the south side; drag back to 40°N and it returns to "south"; on the subsolar latitude it shows "overhead"
北回归线以北恒在南 · 以南恒在北: North of the Tropic of Cancer always south · south of the Tropic of Capricorn always north
方向由观测点纬度与直射点纬度之差决定：观测点比直射点更北，正午太阳就在南方。: The direction depends on the difference between the observer's latitude and the subsolar latitude: if the observer is further north than the subsolar point, the noon sun is in the south.
北回归线以北 φ 总是大于 δ，所以全年正午太阳都在南方；南回归线以南反之。: North of the Tropic of Cancer φ is always greater than δ, so the noon sun is in the south all year; south of the Tropic of Capricorn the reverse.
只有在南北回归线之间，δ 会超过 φ，正午太阳的方向才随季节南北翻号。: Only between the tropics can δ exceed φ, so only there does the noon sun switch between north and south with the seasons.
去掉这一步：会把「正午太阳在南方」当成全球通用，热带的同学最容易记反。: Without this step: you take "the noon sun is in the south" as true everywhere; students in the tropics most easily get it backwards.
易错：北回归线以北全年在南方（不是「夏天在北方」）；20°N 夏至正午太阳在北方: Common mistake: north of the Tropic of Cancer it is in the south all year (not "in the north in summer"); at 20°N the noon sun is in the north at the June solstice and in the south at the December solstice, sometimes south and sometimes north during the year.
北回归线以北全年正午太阳在南方，南回归线以南全年在北方；南北回归线之间，一年里正: North of the Tropic of Cancer the noon sun is in the south all year, south of the Tropic of Capricorn in the north all year; between the tropics it is sometimes south and sometimes north, and directly overhead when the sun is overhead.
facts A2.2 第 5 条（教材 p.12）、B2.1 ⑦: facts A2.2 item 5 (textbook p. 12), B2.1 ⑦
为什么北半球 6、7、8 月算夏天，南半球却是冬天？: Why are June, July and August summer in the Northern Hemisphere but winter in the Southern?
同一天（夏至）把观测点从 40°N 换到 40°S，看两格季节读数: On the same day (June solstice) move the observer from 40°N to 40°S and watch the two season readings
「北半球季节」仍是「夏」，「当地季节」由「夏」变成「冬」；直射点还在 23.4°: "Northern Hemisphere season" is still "summer", while "local season" changes from "summer" to "winter"; the subsolar point stays at 23.4°N; on the two horizon plates the sun is high at 40°N (73.4°) and low at 40°S (26.6°); most of the Northern Hemisphere is on the lit side and most of the Southern on the dark side
太阳辐射的年变化 → 四季: Annual change in solar radiation → seasons
教材气候统计口径：3–5 春、6–8 夏、9–11 秋、12–2 冬: Textbook climatological convention: Mar–May spring, Jun–Aug summer, Sep–Nov autumn, Dec–Feb winter
由于昼夜长短和正午太阳高度的时空变化，太阳辐射在一年中呈现有规律的变化，形成四季: Because day length and noon sun altitude change over time and place, solar radiation varies regularly through the year, giving the seasons.
从天文含义看，夏季是一年内白昼最长、正午太阳高度最高的季节（昼长归 GEO-01: In the astronomical sense, summer is the season with the longest days and highest noon sun of the year (day length belongs to GEO-01; here it is text only).
教材在气候统计上把 3、4、5 月划为春季，6、7、8 月划为夏季，9、10、1: For climate statistics the textbook takes March, April, May as spring, June, July, August as summer, September, October, November as autumn, and December, January, February as winter; the Southern Hemisphere is exactly the opposite.
去掉这一步：会把两套季节口径混为一谈，或者以为全地球同时过同一个季节。: Without this step: you mix up the two season conventions, or think the whole Earth has the same season at once.
易错：天文四季与气候统计四季要在同一句话里分清；南北半球季节相反；四季不是「地球: Common mistake: keep astronomical and climatological seasons apart in the same sentence; the hemispheres have opposite seasons; seasons are not caused by "how far Earth is from the sun".
太阳辐射的年变化形成四季；气候统计上北温带许多国家 3–5 月春、6–8 月夏、: The annual change in solar radiation creates the seasons; for climate statistics many countries in the north temperate zone take March–May as spring, June–August summer, September–November autumn and December–February winter, and the Southern Hemisphere is exactly the opposite.
facts A2.3 第 1–3 条（教材 p.12–13）、A2.4 第 9: facts A2.3 items 1–3 (textbook pp. 12–13), A2.4 item 9
热带、温带、寒带的界线，为什么落在两组纬度上？: Why do the boundaries of the tropical, temperate and frigid zones fall on two pairs of latitudes?
把观测点从 40°N 拖到 80°N，再拖到赤道、拖到 80°S，看五带读数怎样: Drag the observer from 40°N to 80°N, then to the equator and to 80°S, and see how the zone reading changes
五带读数由「北温带」变成「北寒带」；球面上 66°34′ 那条极圈正是分界；拖到: The zone reading changes from "north temperate" to "north frigid"; the polar circle at 66°34′ on the globe is exactly the boundary; at 80°S you get "south frigid", at the equator "tropical"; the zones are flat-colored as in Fig. 1.18: tropical orange, temperate light green, frigid light blue, with boundary latitudes marked on the left edge of the globe
